Optimized Dual-Glo assay to identify co-culture induced drug vulnerabilities using donated chemical probes and chemogenomics kinase set in O06 CRC organoid and F06 CAF mono and co-culture. Organoid is transduced with Luciferase2-P2A-EGFP (Luc2/GFP) lentivirus as described (Schnalzger et al., 2019) and fibroblast is transduced with the original Renilla-dsRed lentivirus (Ren/DsRed; Farin et al., 2023), a codon optimized Renilla-dsRed (Ren (co. opt.)/DsRed), and a codon optimized Renilla-dsRed (Ren*/DsRed) lentivirus, which additionally includes two protein destabilization sequences; hCL1 and hPEST fragments. Cell viability is reported both mono and co-culture models.

Image-based profiling of donated chemical probes and chemogenomic kinase set in O06 CRC organoid. Image analysis is performed on the sum area metric, and the data were normalized to the DMSO control. After imaging the organoid viability is measured using the OneGloEX Luciferase Assay System. The normalized viability data and sum area are reported.

Cytotoxicity screening of chemical probes in isolated B cell assay. Data is normalized to DMSO control, the cell viability average of replicates are reported. Reduction of ATP level more than 20% indicate compromised cell health status.

Cell viability is assessed by cellular ATP assay using CellTiter-Glo Luminescent kit. Viability is expressed as average RLU from biological replicates and normalized to negative control.Toxicity is defined as those with normalized ATP significantly less than 80 percent of the negative control.
